result:
Fixed in `anthrouter/pace.py`. `period_workday_dates` took the local date of `period_end`, which is the exclusive first instant of the next month. For UTC that pulled Oct 1 (a Thursday) into September's count, giving 23 workdays instead of 22. It now uses the date of the last instant before `period_end`.

The full suite had 3 failures in `tests/test_handlers.py`. I re-ran two of them with my change stashed and they fail the same way, so they predate it. I didn't identify or re-run the third.

I didn't add a regression test for September 2026, since you said to change source only.
